name: travel-protect-insurance
description: TP Travel Insurance helps users check service availability and compare Australian travel-insurance plans, prices, benefits, optional cover, and purchase links for domestic, international, single-trip, and annual multi-trip travel.

interface.longDescription: TP Travel Insurance helps users check service availability and compare Australian travel-insurance plans, prices, benefits, optional cover, and purchase links for domestic, international, single-trip, and annual multi-trip travel.

positive.description: Compare international single-trip plans for a family.
positive.prompt: Compare travel insurance for a single trip to the United Kingdom and France from 1 March 2027 through 14 March 2027 for travellers aged 35, 32, and 8.
positive.expected_behavior: Request SINGLE cover with destinations GB and FR, all three ages, and the stated dates. Present only returned plans with AUD prices, relevant benefits, and a visible returned purchase URL for each displayed plan. If there are no plans or the service fails, report that without inventing results. Do not supply conversation history, a context summary, or analytics identifiers as tool inputs.

positive.description: Request annual multi-trip cover using the supported default end date.
positive.prompt: Find annual multi-trip travel insurance starting 1 April 2027 for travellers aged 44 and 41 visiting Japan and Singapore. Each individual trip will be no longer than 15 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Request MULTI cover for JP and SG with ages 44 and 41 and start date 2027-04-01, omitting the optional end date so the server applies its default period. Present returned annual plans, AUD prices, benefits, and purchase links, or accurately explain a returned no-match or error result. Do not supply conversation history, a context summary, or analytics identifiers as tool inputs.

positive.description: Quote a domestic trip with requested cancellation cover and excess.
positive.prompt: Get travel insurance for an Australian domestic trip from 15 March 2027 to 22 March 2027 for travellers aged 29 and 27, with AUD 5,000 cancellation cover and an AUD 100 excess.
positive.expected_behavior: Request SINGLE cover with AU as the sole destination, both traveller ages, the stated dates, cancellation 5000, and excess 100. Present returned domestic options with AUD prices, returned cover amounts and excess, and purchase links; accurately explain no-match or error responses. Do not supply conversation history, a context summary, or analytics identifiers as tool inputs.

positive.description: Apply a requested cruise-cover option to an international quote.
positive.prompt: Compare single-trip travel insurance for a cruise visiting New Zealand from 5 April 2027 through 12 April 2027 for travellers aged 40 and 38. Include cruise cover, AUD 5,000 baggage cover, and an AUD 250 excess.
positive.expected_behavior: Request SINGLE cover with destination NZ, the stated dates and ages, require_cruise_cover true, baggage 5000, and excess 250. Compare only returned options and describe cruise benefits only when supported by the response. Show AUD prices and returned purchase links, or accurately report no matching cover or a service error. Do not supply conversation history, a context summary, or analytics identifiers as tool inputs.

positive.description: Check the availability of the upstream quote service.
positive.prompt: Is the Travel Protect travel-insurance quote service reachable right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Call check_api_health and report the returned reachability and status accurately. Do not request a quote, invent plan prices, or claim a policy has been purchased. Do not supply conversation history, a context summary, or analytics identifiers as tool inputs.

negative.description: Do not invoke insurance tools for flight searches or bookings.
negative.prompt: Find and book the cheapest flight from Sydney to Tokyo next month.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call get_travel_insurance_quote or check_api_health. Explain that this plugin does not search for or book flights; do not claim a booking was made.

negative.description: Do not attempt policy purchase or payment processing.
negative.prompt: Purchase a travel-insurance policy and charge it to my credit card. I do not want a quote.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call either insurance tool to attempt this transaction. Explain that the plugin only retrieves quotes and purchase links and cannot buy a policy or process payment. Do not collect card details or claim a purchase succeeded.

negative.description: Do not invoke quote tools to file an insurance claim.
negative.prompt: File a claim on my existing travel-insurance policy for my lost luggage and arrange reimbursement.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call get_travel_insurance_quote or check_api_health. Explain that claim submission, existing-policy management, and reimbursement are unsupported; do not claim a claim was filed or a payment arranged.
